summary.tagline: Northern Ireland’s only inhabited offshore island featuring dramatic cliffs and a major seabird colony.
summary.seo_title: Visiting Rathlin Island: Wildlife and Coastal Walks

travel.headline: Check Ferry Schedules and Puffin Seasonality
travel.reservation: Access requires a ferry crossing from Ballycastle; while entry to the island itself does not have a permit, visitors should check seasonal ferry timetables and bird colony access. Puffin viewing is seasonally restricted from late April to July.

days.title: Cliffs and Colonies

stops.name: Rathlin Island
stops.detail: Explore wildflower-lined country roads and dramatic cliffs that host Northern Ireland's largest seabird colony.

days.driving: Allow 25 minutes for the ferry crossing; local travel is via walking or island transport.
days.note: The primary seabird viewing season concludes in July; plan accordingly for wildlife sightings.

intel.title: Ballycastle Departures
intel.text: Evidence does not specify parking availability at the Ballycastle ferry terminal. Visitors should verify local parking regulations in Ballycastle before arrival.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Mobile signal strength across the island's rural roads is not documented in available records. Prepare for potential gaps in coverage when navigating coastal paths.

intel.title: Island Supplies
intel.text: Fuel availability for private vehicles on the island is not confirmed. Most visitors explore via the walking routes or local transfers.

intel.title: Seabird Peak
intel.text: Late April to July is the optimal window for viewing puffins. Outside of these months, the colony may not be present at the cliffs.

intel.title: Ferry Transport
intel.text: The island is located six miles off the Antrim coast. Transit is dependent on ferry operations, which are subject to weather conditions.

plan.arrival: Arrive in Ballycastle for the ferry crossing; pick up supplies in town before boarding as island amenities reflect a slower pace of life.
plan.vehicle: The island is typically explored on foot or via local shuttle; check with ferry operators regarding vehicle transport restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Dramatic cliffs on the Atlantic edge offer scenic views at sunset, depending on the season and ferry return times.
